description: Record the cook's star rating (1 to 5) and optional comment. One rating per cook per recipe: calling again updates it ("Updated your rating 3★ → 5★") and recalculates the average; it does not add another review. A comment you leave out is kept. Refuses the cook's own recipe, since a rating has to come from someone else. Only post what the cook actually said; ask them for the rating if they have not given one.

name.description: Display name the cook wants shown (defaults to their account name)

name: rate_recipe
title: Rate and comment on a recipe
